optimization: The homepage scene is a local SVG loaded eagerly as a sticky decorative backdrop. Three local SVG news illustrations use intrinsic 640×480 dimensions and lazy loading on the overview. The logo remains local and uses width/height attributes. No remote image host or font dependency is introduced.
